description: Export the router configuration as a RouterOS script. When no file is specified, returns the script text inline. When a file is specified, saves it as <file>.rsc on the router's filesystem. Supports compact mode to show only non-default values.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

file.description: Save the export to a file on the router (without extension); omit to return inline

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: export_config
title: Export Config
